source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: What conclusion is supported by three successful tests of a newly edited skill?

options.text: The procedure has enough evidence to begin unattended operation without failure tests
options.feedback: Three successful examples leave failure behavior untested. Persistent operation needs explicit operating conditions and failure testing.

options.text: The procedure has enough evidence to skip a representative test after transfer
options.feedback: A new host can differ in tools, dependencies, and permissions. Success in the original environment does not establish performance there.

options.text: The procedure improved performance even though no run without it was compared
options.feedback: Successful outputs show that the tested runs met requirements. A matched comparison with and without the skill is needed to assess its added value.

options.text: The revision worked on those examples and merits further testing
options.feedback: A small set of successes can guide iteration and build limited confidence without proving broad reliability.
